wealthfolio_behavior: Create local agents with provider id, model id, persona, enabled flag, and schedule flag.
edge_cases: Provider disabled; missing API key; model removed from catalog; duplicate names; disabled agent selected.
test_scenarios: Create agent with enabled provider; reject blank name/provider/model; update persona; delete unused agent; run agent with missing API key returns failed run.

wealthfolio_behavior: Create active paper-trading challenges with market, universe, cash, max position %, max drawdown %, cadence, and local scheduled time.
edge_cases: Empty universe means open stock/ETF universe; invalid cash; max position over 100%; ended/settled challenge; duplicate challenge names.
test_scenarios: Create default US-stock challenge; create open-universe challenge; settle challenge; verify challenge appears in route and API.

wealthfolio_behavior: Join agents to challenges idempotently; each participant gets starting cash equal to challenge initial cash.
edge_cases: Agent already joined; deleted agent; disabled agent; missing challenge; settled challenge.
test_scenarios: Join same agent twice and verify one participant; join multiple providers; list participants after reload.

wealthfolio_behavior: Run one agent manually or scheduled using configured Wealthfolio AI providers and strict JSON output.
edge_cases: Provider timeout; malformed JSON; fenced markdown JSON; no orders; no runner configured; disabled agent.
test_scenarios: Run OpenAI/Gemini/Claude-compatible providers; parse fenced JSON; failed run stores error; successful run stores raw and parsed JSON.

wealthfolio_behavior: Validate long-only buy/sell decisions before execution; store rejected orders with reasons.
edge_cases: Unsupported side; negative notional; buy over cash; sell over holdings; max position breach; unsupported asset type; metal/bond-like asset.
test_scenarios: Reject short sale; reject overspend; reject over max position; execute valid buy; execute valid partial/full sell.

feature: Security universe and asset type guard
wealthfolio_behavior: Restrict challenge decisions to stocks/ETFs through local assets or quote provider resolution.
edge_cases: Unknown symbol; provider quote unavailable; crypto/metal/bond/fund-like names; non-USD quote currency; stale local price.
test_scenarios: Resolve AAPL/SPY; reject BTC/gold/bond symbols; fallback to last arena trade price when quote missing.

wealthfolio_behavior: Rebuild each participant portfolio from executed trades plus current quotes; compute cash, positions, return %, drawdown, equity curve.
edge_cases: Partial sells; repeated buys average price; rejected trades ignored; zero positions; missing latest quotes.
test_scenarios: Buy twice then sell once; verify average cost; rejected orders not in holdings; cash equals initial minus executed buys plus sells.

wealthfolio_behavior: Upsert participant snapshots after runs and leaderboard calculations for replayable historical values.
edge_cases: Same-day rerun; missing snapshot date; empty portfolio; current quote changes after snapshot.
test_scenarios: Run agent twice same day; verify snapshot replaced not duplicated; leaderboard reads latest portfolio state.

wealthfolio_behavior: Rank agents by return or risk-adjusted score with drawdown disqualification support.
edge_cases: No participants; equal scores; drawdown above limit; settled challenge; no trades.
test_scenarios: Build leaderboard for zero-trade participants; disqualify max drawdown breach; settle stores final ranked results.

wealthfolio_behavior: Store manual or model-produced thesis records with symbol, rating, confidence, horizon, risks, and catalysts.
edge_cases: Blank thesis; symbol casing; confidence outside 0-1; missing challenge; deleted agent/run.
test_scenarios: Create manual thesis; model run stores thesis decisions; filter theses by symbol and challenge.

wealthfolio_behavior: Run enabled schedule agents for active challenges; idempotency key prevents duplicate cadence execution.
edge_cases: Disabled schedule; disabled agent; settled challenge; no participants; repeated same cadence window.
test_scenarios: Run due endpoint twice; verify second call reuses/skips duplicate key; scheduled agents only.

wealthfolio_behavior: Keep failed run record with prompt and error; avoid executing trades when model call fails.
edge_cases: Missing API key; network failure; provider returns non-JSON; provider returns partial JSON.
test_scenarios: Force missing key; verify failed status and no trade rows; force malformed JSON; verify parsed error.

wealthfolio_behavior: Expose same commands through Axum REST in web mode and Tauri IPC in desktop mode.
edge_cases: REST path param mismatch; camelCase query mismatch; command payload mismatch; auth-protected server route.
test_scenarios: Call create/list/run/leaderboard/theses from desktop and web adapters; type-check shared frontend adapter.

wealthfolio_behavior: Add top-level AI Arena workbench to create agents/challenges, join agents, run matches, view leaderboard/trades/runs/portfolio, and write theses.
edge_cases: No providers enabled; no challenge selected; no participants; long names; mobile widths; pending mutation states.
test_scenarios: Render empty state; create objects; select challenge/participant; run agent; inspect rejected trade; write thesis.

wealthfolio_behavior: Store all arena data in local SQLite migrations with Diesel schema and repositories.
edge_cases: Migration rollback; foreign-key deletion; JSON serialization; decimal precision in text columns.
test_scenarios: Run migrations; rollback migration; create rows through repository; reload after app restart.
